_comment: Commerce's rights, shipped as a library layer. They name only the 'Commerce' pseudo-type this library reserves,
and only its own slots, which the application binds in its security.json:
An unbound slot refuses startup. Moderation's reviewers (Review/Moderation) may decide DSA notices too.
Seller staff are checked by their organization role (Admin/Owner, or the 'finance'/'seller-admin' custom roles), not here.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce": false }.
